description: If program \(j\) computes \(x\mapsto\varphi_x(x)+1\), with partial-value equality on every input, then \(\varphi_j(j)\) is undefined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.partial_diagonal_diverges (j : ℕ)
  (h :
    ∀ (x : ℕ),
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.phi j x =
        Part.map Nat.succ (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.phi x x)) :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.UniversalComputation.phi j j).Dom
